notes:
Scope and limits: static read of the 16 machines plus shared juice/fx/audio code. Nothing was run, no audio or visual timing was checked, and no files were changed. seatHud.ts, the particle step functions and tween internals were not read in detail. Line numbers were checked against the working tree as it stood during this read.

Verified facts behind the top gaps: juice.ts:121-122 documents amount as 'Coins won', yet seven callers pass a gross return. The juiceTier tag check (tiers.ts:23) ignores every tag except jackpot, which is why blackjack and dicetower tags do nothing. gamble:fx is emitted only by the shared risk layer (MachineBase.ts:675), so bandit's custom HI/LO skips it.

Anticipation quality by machine, for the reel-slowing, ball-bounce and last-card question: bigone (crawl and riser), coinflip (edge balance, near-miss lean, slow-mo), cyclone (armed reveal, coast with falling ticks), bigsix (exponential decay with a flapper per peg) and claw (grip LED on close) do this well. bandit (fixed stagger, reel 3 not slowed), craps (no slowed landing), baccarat (third card in one move), blackjack (no dealer suspense) and coinpusher (no danger tension) do not. derby's race is keyframed, so there is no slow tail; its photo finish is the one cue, and its near miss is after the finish (derby/index.ts:477).

Decision conflict to flag, not a gap: DECISIONS.md:89 says machines use winJingle and SFX, never music.stinger. The musical stinger library (stingers.ts, including jackpot, bigWin, buff, debuff) therefore sits unused. Revisiting that decision would unlock a musical mega or jackpot cue, roughly impact 3, effort M, but it needs an owner's decision first.

Smaller findings not in the top 20: devilstable hard-codes medium at index.ts:566 and x1.9 at :647; escalate 'big' adds a second shake on top of winBurst's big shake (fx.ts:197 and juice.ts:222); bingo's popText for other desks is the only spectator cue for big wins.
